page.layout: One printed page (right page of an opening). Running head at top centre, page number at top right. Main text in one column with a large woodcut initial at the start. Table of numbers in the middle of the text block. Left edge shows part of the facing page, which is not transcribed.

main_text.head: ANTVM de proportione Arithmetica: sequitur Geometrica, quae est rationum aequalitas.
main_text.p: Τῶν λόγων ταυτότης ἐν ὅροις. Verum hic Rationis uox non generaliter, sed uoce specifica sumitur, pro quotorum aequalitate, quae inter comparatos numeros cernitur. Vt in 2.6.4.12, quae ratio est inter 2 & 6, eadem inter 4 & 12, utrobiq; subtripla. Si uero quatuor numeri directè fuerint proportionales: idem etiam inuerse & alterne, ac caeteris item proportionis modis Logicis, proportionales erunt. 16 d. 5, & 13 p.7. cum eadem consectariis, in hunc modum:
Est autem haec quoq; duplex, Disiuncta scilicet, & Continua.
Disiuncta est, quae neque terminis, neq; rationibus cohaeret.
Vt in 6 3 16 8, hic enim duae duplae sunt, & terminis distinctae, & rationibus, eò quod inter 3 & 16 eadem ratio non seruetur, quae inter 6 & 3, atque inter 16 & 8.
Disiuncta in quatuor ad minimùm terminis consistit.

page.notes: Left margin partly holds text of the facing page (e.g. "IV.", "CAP. XV.", "CAP. XVI.", "Geometrica", "Arithmetica"), which is not transcribed. Greek line and table cells are as read; the woodcut initial is an A decorated letter, read as "A". The signature line "F 4 Pro-" is a catchword-like mark at the foot and is given as printed text.
